title: Closed adic direct image preserves bounded constructibility
statement: Fix a prime l. For a scheme V let Qbar_l,V be the sheaf of locally finite continuous functions to an algebraic closure of Q_l: locally on V the values lie in a finite extension of Q_l. Let AdicSheaf_l(V) be the abelian category of modules over this sheaf, and call such a sheaf constructible if Zariski locally it admits a finite partition by locally closed constructible subschemes on which it is pro-etale locally finite free. These are the concrete sheaf models of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Write D^b_c(V) for the objects of the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] which are bounded for its standard t-structure and have constructible cohomology. Let i:Z -> X be a closed immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] with X noetherian. For any A in D^b_c(Z), its ordinary derived direct image Ri_*A belongs to D^b_c(X).

source.place: Sections 6.1 and 6.8, closed-immersion recollement; closed-direct-image step of sk-prop-sf-finiteness.

proof.text: The closed subscheme Z is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For a constructible adic sheaf F, choose its finite lisse stratification on Z. The counit i^* i_* F -> F is an isomorphism by [lem-exc-proetale-closed-fully-faithful], also after passage to module objects over the adic coefficient sheaf: the forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms and the module adjunction has this underlying counit. On the open complement U, the restriction of i_* F is zero, by the empty-fibre formula. Combining the stratification of Z with the zero sheaf on U proves constructibility of i_* F.

The open complement is quasi-compact because X is noetherian. By [lem-exc-proetale-closed-exact], closed direct image of underlying module sheaves preserves finite colimits. The forgetful functor from module objects over the adic coefficient sheaf preserves and reflects these colimits, so adic i_* is exact too.

An exact additive functor has right derived functor isomorphic to its functor on derived categories. It preserves both standard t-structure bounds and commutes with every cohomology functor. Thus Ri_*A is bounded and its cohomology is i_*H^n(A), which is constructible by step 1. This is the compiled rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso calculation.
